body:
Heyo, i'm iwishbro, or Aaron.

I'm looking for a team to play competitively with. It has been a long time since i've played with a team competitively, but i feel as if the time for my return is now. 

What i'm good at: 
Midfielder
Defense

What i'm not good at:
Frontliner
Rusher

Hopefully you guys take this under consideration. Though, i have not played a lot in past few months, i'' sure i can still PVP to the best of my levels.
